descriptions: Cluster 1: higher air temperature, higher process temperature. Observed higher failure proportion in this dataset (5.2% vs 3.4% overall). This describes association only, not cause.
Cluster 2: lower air temperature, lower process temperature. Observed lower failure proportion in this dataset (2.2% vs 3.4% overall). This describes association only, not cause.
Cluster 3: higher rotational speed, lower torque. Observed lower failure proportion in this dataset (2.2% vs 3.4% overall). This describes association only, not cause.
